title: MIMI ↔ Marmot bridge
description: Bridge MIMI rooms and Marmot (White Noise) groups in relay mode: a front end in mimid-agent (crate mimid-agent-marmot, name not final) that drives MDK's wn-agent over its marmot.agent-control.v2 socket. Design note: docs/design/marmot-bridge.md, on branch marmot-bridge-note (commit 26b41a9), following option (b) of docs/design/nostr-comparison.md. Code waits for Mark's review of the note and his answers to its open questions (§10). No sub-issues are filed until he approves the step plan (§9).
